content:
The execution failed the `test_word_summary_content` check in the Word document (`/root/Cycle_Count_Variance_Brief.docx`). 

Specifically, the document failed to mention at least two high-priority `(Facility, Session ID)` combinations with the most exceptions. The test expects these combinations to be formatted as "Facility-SessionID" or "Facility SessionID" (case-insensitive). 

While the Excel file generation likely succeeded (5/6 internal tests passed), the Word document logic needs to be updated to explicitly identify and name the top two Facility-Session pairs based on the `Total Errors` column calculated in the Summary sheet.
reasoning: The trace reveals a specific failure in the Word document content despite the Excel logic likely being correct. Identifying the exact missing requirement (mentioning specific high-priority facility-session IDs) allows the Planner to fix the document generation logic.
